title: Arrest without warrant
question: What does Nigeria Immigration Act section 24 say about arrest without warrant?
shortAnswer: Nigeria Immigration Act s.24 — Immigration officer may arrest without warrant: suspected prohibited immigrant, person evading immigration control, forged documents.
legalExplanation:
**Section 24 of the Nigeria Immigration Act** provides:

Immigration officer may arrest without warrant: suspected prohibited immigrant, person evading immigration control, forged documents

This provision empowers Nigeria Immigration Act officers with specific powers and duties.
practicalOptions: Stay calm. Know your rights. Ask for identification. Do not resist. Ask for lawyer. Document everything.
